Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know what you need me to do next.

It looks like my phone currently can’t send MMS messages, and I’m also not able to use mobile data or make calls since there’s no cellular service. Airplane mode appears to be on, and my SIM card isn’t being detected. What should I do next?
I’ve turned off Airplane mode, but my phone still isn’t detecting the SIM card. There’s no signal showing, and it says there’s no SIM card inserted. What should I do next?

I reseated the SIM card and powered my phone back on. Now the SIM card is detected, and I have a poor signal on a 2G network. However, mobile data is still disabled, and I’m not connected to Wi-Fi. What should I do next to get MMS working?

I’ve enabled mobile data and switched my network mode to prefer 4G/5G. My phone now shows an excellent 5G signal with data enabled. However, I still can’t send MMS messages—there’s no specific error message, but the messages just won’t send. What should I try next?

I checked my APN settings, and it looks like the MMSC URL for picture messages isn’t set. Should I go ahead and reset my APN settings to default, or do you want to provide the correct MMSC URL for me to enter?

I’ve reset my APN settings to default and rebooted my phone as you instructed. Unfortunately, I still can’t send MMS messages. Is there anything else I should try? I’m starting to get a bit frustrated since it’s still not working.
Wi-Fi Calling is currently turned on. Should I go ahead and turn it off now and then try sending an MMS again? Let me know if you also want me to check the messaging app permissions.

I turned off Wi-Fi Calling and tried sending an MMS again, but it still didn’t work. I also checked my messaging app’s permissions—it has SMS and phone permissions, but not storage. Should I enable storage permission for the messaging app and try again?
I’ve enabled storage permission for the messaging app and tried sending an MMS again, but it still isn’t working. Is there anything else I should try?

1. Turn off Airplane mode on your phone. This will re-enable all wireless connections, including cellular service.
2. Once Airplane mode is off, check if your SIM card is detected. If it’s still not detected, please remove your SIM card and reinsert it to ensure it’s properly seated.
